features: COLOR & FEEL: The sheet set offers a crisp, smooth, and comfortable feel. The Azalea Skye Oshun features a beautiful grey watercolor stripe on a white ground

description: Update your bedding ensemble with a new Washed Cotton Printed Sheet Set from Azalea Skye. With 100% quality cotton construction, these beautiful sheet sets allow you to experience maximum comfort and feature an ultra soft and breathable feel. The sheet set is made from 144 thread count, plain weave cotton for a delightfully comfortable addition to your bedroom decor. Sheet set includes one flat sheet, one fitted sheet, and two pillowcases (one for twin sizes). Sets contain a fully elasticized fitted sheet to prevent slipping from your mattress and ensure a perfect fit. Sheets are machine washable for easy and convenient care.
